message.content: According to the interactions recorded, Adam Smith advises Li Hua to use removable hooks when hanging her new artwork on the walls to ensure it does not cause any damage. This suggestion comes from a conversation regarding Li Hua's plans to decorate her space, specifically mentioning that she should "hang your artwork as long as you don't damage the walls." Adam Smith provides additional guidance by suggesting the use of removable hooks, ensuring that the artwork can be safely installed and removed if needed.
